easyPrerequisites: The card in your graveyard is Stream of Life.
description:
Cast a copy of Stream of Life with X=0 by paying {G}.
Nantuko Shrine and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Nantuko Shrine trigger, creating at least one 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten, blinking Infirmary Healer, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding one mana.
Repeat.
